about.description:
DD4hep is a software framework for providing a complete solution for
full detector description (geometry, materials, visualization, readout,
alignment, calibration, etc.) for high energy physics experiments.
It uses the ROOT geometry package and adds support for detector
alignment, conditions, and simulation with Geant4.
about.summary: Detector Description Toolkit for High Energy Physics

script:
mkdir -p build
cd build
# DDParsers exports DD4HEP_USE_GEANT4_UNITS as a PUBLIC compile definition,
# so this fixes mm/MeV/ns as the units for everything built against dd4hep.
# Upstream and key4hep both default it off, so do not "restore" the default
# without rebuilding dependents: the change is silent at compile time.
cmake ${CMAKE_ARGS} \
    -GNinja \
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
    -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$PREFIX \
    -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON \
    -DDD4HEP_USE_GEANT4=ON \
    -DDD4HEP_USE_XERCESC=ON \
    -DDD4HEP_USE_GEANT4_UNITS=ON \
    -DDD4HEP_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF \
    -DDD4HEP_RELAX_PYVER=ON \
    -DPython_EXECUTABLE=$PYTHON \
    -DPython_ROOT_DIR=$PREFIX \
    -DPython_FIND_STRATEGY=LOCATION \
    $SRC_DIR
cmake --build . --target install

about.description:
DD4hep is a software framework for providing a complete solution for
full detector description (geometry, materials, visualization, readout,
alignment, calibration, etc.) for high energy physics experiments.
It uses the ROOT geometry package and adds support for detector
alignment, conditions, and simulation with Geant4.
about.summary: Detector Description Toolkit for High Energy Physics

script:
mkdir -p build
cd build
# DDParsers exports DD4HEP_USE_GEANT4_UNITS as a PUBLIC compile definition,
# so this fixes mm/MeV/ns as the units for everything built against dd4hep.
# Upstream and key4hep both default it off, so do not "restore" the default
# without rebuilding dependents: the change is silent at compile time.
cmake ${CMAKE_ARGS} \
    -GNinja \
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
    -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$PREFIX \
    -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON \
    -DDD4HEP_USE_GEANT4=ON \
    -DDD4HEP_USE_XERCESC=ON \
    -DDD4HEP_USE_GEANT4_UNITS=ON \
    -DDD4HEP_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF \
    -DDD4HEP_RELAX_PYVER=ON \
    -DPython_EXECUTABLE=$PYTHON \
    -DPython_ROOT_DIR=$PREFIX \
    -DPython_FIND_STRATEGY=LOCATION \
    $SRC_DIR
cmake --build . --target install

name: dd4hep

about.description:
DD4hep is a software framework for providing a complete solution for
full detector description (geometry, materials, visualization, readout,
alignment, calibration, etc.) for high energy physics experiments.
It uses the ROOT geometry package and adds support for detector
alignment, conditions, and simulation with Geant4.
about.summary: Detector Description Toolkit for High Energy Physics

script:
mkdir -p build
cd build
# DDParsers exports DD4HEP_USE_GEANT4_UNITS as a PUBLIC compile definition,
# so this fixes mm/MeV/ns as the units for everything built against dd4hep.
# Upstream and key4hep both default it off, so do not "restore" the default
# without rebuilding dependents: the change is silent at compile time.
cmake ${CMAKE_ARGS} \
    -GNinja \
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
    -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$PREFIX \
    -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON \
    -DDD4HEP_USE_GEANT4=ON \
    -DDD4HEP_USE_XERCESC=ON \
    -DDD4HEP_USE_GEANT4_UNITS=ON \
    -DDD4HEP_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF \
    -DDD4HEP_RELAX_PYVER=ON \
    -DPython_EXECUTABLE=$PYTHON \
    -DPython_ROOT_DIR=$PREFIX \
    -DPython_FIND_STRATEGY=LOCATION \
    $SRC_DIR
cmake --build . --target install

context:
  name: dd4hep

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version|replace('-', '.') }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/archive/refs/tags/v0${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 8a11c42cfd2026faae421260bc3dea9f61c78ebacd1f9ba1b0ca3ff054425ffd
  patches:
    - patches/0001-fix-auto-detect-C-standard-from-ROOT-if-not-explicit.patch
    - patches/0002-fix-remove-overly-conservative-Geant4-C-standard-che.patch
    - patches/0003-fix-auto-detect-plugin-search-path-at-runtime.patch
    - patches/0004-fix-auto-detect-DD4hepINSTALL-at-runtime.patch
    - patches/0005-fix-remove-DD4HEP_LIBRARY_PATH-requirement-from-Pyth.patch
    - patches/0006-fix-define-_LIBCPP_DISABLE_AVAILABILITY-on-macOS.patch

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - win
    - ppc64le
    - osx and x86_64
    # Geant4Converter.cpp calls the three-argument
    # G4MaterialPropertiesTable::AddProperty, which only exists from Geant4
    # 11.0. CMakeLists.txt still advertises 10.2.2 as the minimum, but the call
    # is not guarded by G4VERSION_NUMBER.
    - match(geant4, "<11")
  script:
    - if: linux
      then: export CFLAGS="${CFLAGS} -fno-merge-constants" export CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS} -fno-merge-constants"
    # DDG4's Python plugins link with -undefined dynamic_lookup, so listcomponents
    # has to preload libpython to resolve their Python symbols. Upstream added the
    # DD4HEP_GENERATE_ROOTMAP_EXTRA_ENV hook for exactly this in v01-38.
    - if: osx
      then: export CMAKE_ARGS="${CMAKE_ARGS} -DDD4HEP_GENERATE_ROOTMAP_EXTRA_ENV=DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES=${PREFIX}/lib/libpython${PY_VER}.dylib"
    - |
      mkdir -p build
      cd build
      # DDParsers exports DD4HEP_USE_GEANT4_UNITS as a PUBLIC compile definition,
      # so this fixes mm/MeV/ns as the units for everything built against dd4hep.
      # Upstream and key4hep both default it off, so do not "restore" the default
      # without rebuilding dependents: the change is silent at compile time.
      cmake ${CMAKE_ARGS} \
          -GNinja \
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
          -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$PREFIX \
          -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON \
          -DDD4HEP_USE_GEANT4=ON \
          -DDD4HEP_USE_XERCESC=ON \
          -DDD4HEP_USE_GEANT4_UNITS=ON \
          -DDD4HEP_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF \
          -DDD4HEP_RELAX_PYVER=ON \
          -DPython_EXECUTABLE=$PYTHON \
          -DPython_ROOT_DIR=$PREFIX \
          -DPython_FIND_STRATEGY=LOCATION \
          $SRC_DIR
      cmake --build . --target install

requirements:
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cmake
    - ninja
    - git
  host:
    - python
    - libboost-devel
    - root_base
    - root_cxx_standard
    - geant4
    # Geant4Config.cmake unconditionally calls find_dependency(EXPAT), but the
    # geant4 package only pulls in libexpat, which ships no headers. Drop this
    # once geant4 carries expat at runtime again.
    - expat
    - xerces-c
    - tbb-devel
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - dd4hep
      pip_check: false
  - script:

  - script:
